scope: Field-level authority, provenance, corrections and evidence requirements for Fortnite lore claims

principles.official_story_first: Fortnite News or another Epic/Fortnite page directly publishing the story fact is primary.
principles.field_authority: A source confirms only the lore field it actually states; official status alone does not authorize unrelated inference.
principles.source_url_for_new_strong_claims: Every new V2 OFFICIAL_EXPLICIT/OFFICIAL_CROSS_REFERENCE claim must preserve the exact official source URL used as evidence.
principles.cosmetic_not_canon: Cosmetic descriptions, shop availability and collaboration presence do not establish main-story canon unless an authorized story source explicitly does so.
principles.gameplay_not_lore: Gameplay mechanics, NPC spawn tables and boss encounters do not by themselves establish membership, alliance or causation.
principles.no_fan_wiki_as_fact: Community wikis/videos/social posts may help discovery only and never become canonical evidence.
principles.correction_not_overwrite: A later official correction creates a new claim linked by supersedes_claim_id; earlier evidence stays auditable.
principles.scope_required_for_temporal_relationship: Leadership, affiliation, NPC/Boss roles, opposition and event participation should carry chapter/season/event/date scope whenever the official evidence is contextual.

CURATED_LEGACY_OFFICIAL.note: Readable legacy seed pending URL enrichment.

claim_status_policy.PROVISIONAL: Official signal not strong/final enough for strong materialization.
claim_status_policy.DISPUTED: Conflicting official evidence unresolved; query/history only.
claim_status_policy.SUPERSEDED: Replaced by a newer claim; history only by default.
claim_status_policy.RETRACTED: Explicitly withdrawn/corrected by official source; history only.

conflict_resolution.field_specific: Resolve only the conflicting predicate/scope, not the whole entity.
conflict_resolution.newer_not_automatically_better: Publication recency alone does not supersede an older fact unless the newer source actually corrects or changes it.
conflict_resolution.different_scope_can_coexist: Different seasons/chapters/events may legitimately carry different affiliations, roles or locations.
conflict_resolution.official_conflict: If two equally authoritative official sources conflict and neither corrects the other, mark DISPUTED instead of choosing silently.

legacy_enrichment.policy: CURATED_LEGACY_OFFICIAL V1 facts remain queryable; when an official URL is found, add/enrich a V2 claim rather than silently changing semantic strength.
